- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#8 ("Request: large-d tree-model extension (Arrhythmia, d=279) or the reason it cannot be run") by `experiment-repo`  > Large-d extension is delivered: Arrhythmia, d = 279, RF and GBM, 40 instances, R = 20 (`experiment-repo` main fbccf69; paper-repo `dev` d9d1eac). Files: `results/tables/large_d_arrhythmia.csv` (summary), `_instances.csv`, `_reference.csv`, and the README section "Large-d extension".
  > 
  > **What it is computed on.** UCI Arrhythmia (452 rows, 279 attributes, "any arrhythmia" vs normal, median-filled), main-grid split and background (B = 50, seed 0), RF P(class 1) and GBM raw margin. No value table exists at d = 279, so the **reference is interventional TreeSHAP on the same background**, not exact enumeration; additivity: GBM exact to 1e-7; RF median gap 5e-5 but 7 of 40 instances above 1e-3 (max 0.0076, 12 % of f(x) − base for that instance), cause not found (not float32 input rounding). Only `shap` Kernel was run (`l1_reg` False, `auto` at the default budget, the shap default `num_features(10)`), budgets 256 (< d), 1024 and 2d + 2048 = 2606.
  > 
  > **Results (k = 3, strict P_c, instance mean; CI by instance bootstrap).**
  > - shap default at m = 2606: GBM 0.38 (0.26–0.51), RF 0.25 (0.15–0.35); tolerance-aware 0.53 / 0.35; run-to-run agreement 0.77 / 0.68; mean Pearson 0.75 / 0.68; share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9: 0.25 / 0.10. It fails more severely than at d ≥ 16, for the same reason (lasso path).
  > - `l1_reg` False at m = 2606: 0.988 / 0.949 (tolerance-aware 1.0 / 1.0), Pearson 1.000 / 0.997; at m = 1024: 0.964 / 0.875; at m = 256 < d: P_c 0.00 (Pearson 0.05–0.07). `auto` at 2606: 0.990 / 0.954. The residual failures sit in the lowest margin quartile (RF Q1 0.82).
  > - H1 (strict, share P_c ≥ 0.9): for the default the aggregate is not high (Pearson < 0.9), so H1's first condition fails although the decision-level share is 0.25 / 0.10; for `l1_reg` False at 2606 the contrast is 2.5 points (GBM) and 17.2 (RF), tolerance-aware ≈ 0.
  > 
  > **Scope to state.** One dataset, one split, trees only, shap Kernel only, no paired Kernel or permutation, no MLP/LR at d = 279; the reference is TreeSHAP. This supports "the default's failure persists, and worsens, at d = 279" for tree models; it does not give a large-d version of the budget law or the floors.
